lines.says: the arms mostly hold their angle: the trunk turns them
the hands sweep a long way across the body
at the start the hands are together
at the finish the hands are together
the back foot stays near its place, its heel lifting and pivoting
the trunk doesn't fold: it turns
the hands sweep on a diagonal, from high over one shoulder to low past the opposite hip
the trunk and the hips turn with the arms, not the arms alone
the back heel lifts and the foot pivots as the body turns
both hands hold the one handle, one over the other
